summary: You have three problems at once: a submission due tomorrow, a laptop that has stopped working, and a landlord asking you to leave the flat by Monday 5 October while money is tight. The laptop comes first because the submission depends on it. The flat is urgent too, but it has a few days, and you probably have more options there than it feels like right now.

issues.title: Landlord wants the flat khaali by the 5th, and no paise right now

priorities.action: Get onto a working computer tonight: borrow a laptop from a friend or flatmate, or use a college lab or cyber café, and pull your files from email, Drive or your phone
priorities.reason: Nothing on the submission can happen without a working computer. Repairing the laptop can wait until after the deadline.

priorities.action: Finish the parts that carry the most marks first; if you cannot make it, email your teacher tonight and ask for a short extension, mentioning the laptop
priorities.reason: It is due in about 20 hours if it is a morning deadline. Something complete enough and on time usually beats something perfect and late.

priorities.action: After you submit, reply to your landlord asking for the notice in writing and for more time, and check the notice period in your rental agreement
priorities.reason: A few days is very short notice. Rental agreements usually set a notice period, often a month, so you may have more time than it sounds. Getting it in writing protects you either way.

priorities.action: Write down how much you need for the next month (rent, deposit, moving) and who you could ask for a short-term loan
priorities.reason: You do not need to solve the money tonight, but knowing the exact number makes the landlord conversation and any borrowing much easier.

next_action.text: Message two friends or flatmates now asking to borrow a laptop tonight for a few hours.
next_action.why: The submission is blocked until you have a working computer, and asking takes two minutes.

clarifying_questions.question: What time is the submission due tomorrow?
Are your files saved anywhere other than the laptop?
Did your landlord give you the notice in writing?
